We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions, using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We must produce JSON route where each reaction node uses the given template_id (as integer? example uses number). Provide children as precursor molecules (type mol). The route must start from target molecule and go backwards through 5 steps.

We attempted applying template 29646 to target, got three possible precursors (list of three). Need to choose one path that can continue with next template 1914389, etc.

We need to understand each template's transformation. Not given, but we can infer from results.

First apply 29646 to target gave three possible precursors:

Result string: "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO',))"

So three precursors: (1) with two silyl groups? Actually first has CO[Si] and O[Si] both. second has no silyl? third has O[Si] only.

We need to apply next template 1914389 to one of these precursors. We attempted applying to first (with two silyl) and got result: "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C', 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC'),)". So it gave two products? Actually apply_template returns list of precursor SMILES for retrosynthesis. So applying template 1914389 to that precursor gave two possible precursors: one is "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C" and the other "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC". So the template splits something.

We need to continue with template 1914390 next. We tried applying 1914390 to the first of those (the silyl one) and got empty. Also to the second gave empty. So maybe need to choose a different branch.

Maybe we should apply 1914389 to the second precursor from 29646 (no silyl). Let's try.
